'''Pocket Monsters DP''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターD・P編''') is a shōnen [[Pokémon manga]] created by [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. It is a sequel to the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] and [[Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire]] manga series and is succeeded by {{OBP|Pocket Monsters HGSS|Kosaku Anakubo}}. The plot follows the adventures of {{PPM|Red}} and his Pokémon ({{TP|Red|Clefairy}}, {{PPM|Red's Pikachu|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Red|Tyrogue}}) in [[Sinnoh]]. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
